purpose: Test whether chain length alone makes the existing ordinary elliptical-slice FULL shadow trustworthy at n=40.

existing_transition_contract.target: exp(-E_FULL(y)) times the exact current Gaussian BO reference
existing_transition_contract.ellipse_reference: exact current Gaussian BO reference via the existing Matheron sampler
existing_transition_contract.angular_bracket: randomized standard bracket [theta-2*pi, theta] followed by standard shrinkage

initialization.remaining_chains: independent draws from the previously selected curvature-tempered Laplace initialization proposal

final_validation.derivation: big-endian first eight SHA256 bytes modulo (2^32 - 1)

schedule_selection_rule: Evaluate S1, S2, S3 in order on calibration seed 2026082401 and freeze the first global schedule passing every six-state strict gate and every applicable n=24 reference-consistency gate; never inspect a later schedule after a global pass.

n24_reference_consistency_gate.validation_reference: fresh independent pooled 32768x2 baseline Laplace-SNIS calculation, used only after schedule freeze

failure_classification_rule.MCMC_NONCONVERGENCE: maximum required split-Rhat > 1.01 or minimum required gap ESS < 1000
failure_classification_rule.MATERIAL_DECISION_UNCERTAINTY: convergence passes and maximum reciprocal group action regret > 0.01
failure_classification_rule.GLOBAL_VECTOR_ONLY: convergence, group action, and regret <= 0.005 pass and the sole strict failure is the uniform acquisition-vector difference
failure_classification_rule.FINITE_MC_NEAR_TIE: convergence passes, reciprocal group action regret <= 0.01, and remaining decision disagreement is associated with pooled leader/challenger gap magnitude no more than 2 MCSE

strategy_rule.case_a: If the strict gate passes calibration and held-out validation, classify STANDARD_ESS_FULL_REFERENCE_PASS and recommend standard ESS.
strategy_rule.case_b: If all n=40 convergence diagnostics pass and regrets are <= 0.01 but exact action or uniform-vector checks fail, classify BACKEND_HEALTHY_REFERENCE_RULE_TOO_BRITTLE and recommend a prospective decision-aligned reliability-rule task, not another sampler.
strategy_rule.case_c: If material decision disagreement remains under well-mixed chains, recommend one separate generalized elliptical-slice/Gaussian-approximation development step with exact residual correction.
strategy_rule.case_d: If Rhat or gap ESS remains inadequate, classify standard ESS as inadequate at n=40 and recommend a separate sampler-method decision.

runtime_projection.method: Fit the two-point observed power law through median n=24 and n=40 worker seconds at the selected schedule, or at S3 if none passes, and sum nine projected state times at each domain size.
